name: Canva Docs
description: Canva Docs is Canva's unlimited-length document design type for creating and collaborating on visual documents inside the same Canva content library, editor, identity, team, and integration surface.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Canva Docs connection or install. Connect the canonical Canva provider once, then use its bounded design metadata tools and reviewed blank-design workflow with the stable doc preset. Relay does not expose document-body reading or editing because Canva's stable Connect API surface does not provide those semantics.

blocked.label: Create a separate Canva Docs connection
blocked.description: Canva Docs uses the same Canva user, team, OAuth grant, design library, and API as the canonical Canva provider; a second connection would duplicate identity and authority.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Canva Docs tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported design metadata and blank-design actions once through the canonical Canva provider rather than publishing parallel Docs tools and policies.

blocked.label: Read or edit Canva Docs content
blocked.description: The stable bounded Relay Canva surface does not expose document body text, elements, comments, collaboration, arbitrary editing, export, or raw API access.

blocked.label: Run separate Canva Docs actions
blocked.description: Supported Docs discovery and blank creation belong to the selected canonical Canva connection and its existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions profile.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Canva
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Canva Docs actions are enabled because Docs is a Canva design type already governed by Relay's canonical Canva provider.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate Canva Docs tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Canva provider with the doc preset for supported workflows.
No duplicate Canva Docs tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Canva provider with the doc preset for supported workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: Canva Docs is a Canva design type, not a separate provider identity or authorization surface. A second provider card, OAuth grant, credential record, installation, policy, or runtime adapter would duplicate the existing Canva connection. Stable Connect APIs expose Docs design metadata and blank doc creation but not document-body text editing semantics.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-mode slug non-installable and direct discovery, setup, connection, installation, and execution to the canonical Canva provider. Use canva_design_prepare and approval-gated canva_design_create with designType preset and presetName doc for a reviewed blank Canva Doc; use canva_design_list or canva_design_get for bounded metadata. Revisit content reads or editing only if Canva publishes stable, review-eligible typed document APIs and Relay approves their exact scope and data contract.

evidence.supports: Canva defines Documents (Canva Docs) as designs stored with other designs in the same user Projects and notes that Documents have unlimited length.
Canva's stable Create design endpoint accepts doc as a preset within the general designs API under design:content:write and returns the same Design resource used for other Canva design types.
Canva made design type metadata stable in July 2026 and documents doc as a value on shared Design responses, confirming Docs classification inside the canonical design model.
Canva publishes one Connect API integration model for designs and related content, with public integrations subject to Canva review and preview APIs excluded from public review.
